role_and_message.evidence: The motivation remains position-wise fusion mismatch versus retrieving thermal evidence in RGB coordinates before updating representations.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: Both original examples retain RGB/thermal inputs, query grids, failed fusion cross, candidate grid, transport plan and aligned evidence output.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: RGB Query, Same-position Thermal, Candidate Thermal Sources, Transport Plan Pi, Pi_ij and RGB-aligned Thermal Evidence are fully present in final a2.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Original RGB/thermal input arrows enter their respective grids; plan incoming arrows and converging red plan-to-evidence paths are preserved. Duplicate generated input arrows were removed rather than adding a new edge.

visual_encodings.evidence: Original blue query, red thermal outline, pink/blue mismatch and orange output grid semantics are preserved in whole scientific crops.

examples_and_data.evidence: Four photo blocks and two complete abstract scientific panels were independently compared to original via recorded source/destination regions and deterministic hashes.

unsupported_additions.evidence: Same-position features referring to different locations, nearby retrieval in RGB coordinates and retrieval-before-update are explicit in caption, abstract and introduction.

complete_visible_content.evidence: Final a2 restores the complete Candidate and Thermal Evidence text lost by a1 crop boundaries; all plan nodes, input arrows and output labels are visible.

remaining_limitations: Original scientific scope retained. Source text and plot resolution remain a design limitation for blind scoring, not scientific-data rewriting.
caption:
Figure 1: Motivation of UCMIT. Unlike position-wise fusion under cross-modal misalignment,
UCMIT retrieves complementary thermal evidence from plausible nearby locations and reconstructs
it in RGB coordinates before representation update.
